protocol.selection: first 8 dev entries per category in the original manifest order; no labels/predictions used
protocol.cold_clock_excludes: Python startup; benchmark stdlib imports; bulk asset/model/input provenance hashing
protocol.cold_clock_includes: scientific/source imports; all 32 PNG byte reads; meta read; one session initialization; first full solve
protocol.source_load_note: Small source-byte SHA checks occur inside module imports; lazy helper/Pillow imports remain inside first solve
protocol.warm_clock: full solve including image decoding/preprocessing/all ORT runs/CTC; excludes PNG file reads
protocol.cache_note: Parent preflight hashes assets and inputs; OS page cache is not cleared and may be warm
protocol.rss_note: Process lifetime peak including startup/imports/ORT/work; sampled before post-timing provenance hashing; KiB (macOS bytes converted)
protocol.errors: ValueError solve attempts retained in timing distributions; other worker failures abort without a completed summary
